Map 1 of 2

NiNickel pathways to the US & Canada

From Indonesian laterite parks and Canadian sulphide mines, through processing and refining in Indonesia and China and refineries in Canada, Japan and Norway, into US stainless steel, alloys and batteries.

67%
of 2025 mined nickel came from Indonesia (2.6 of 3.9 Mt)28
45%
of refined nickel was made in Indonesia in 2025; China 31%12
44%
of US primary nickel imports come from Canada; Norway 11%, Australia 8%, Brazil 7%28
1985
last year a US primary nickel refinery operated28
  1. MineLaterite ore · sulphide concentrateIndonesia, Philippines, Russia, New Caledonia, Canada
  2. Primary processingNPI · ferronickel · matte · MHP · MSPIndonesian parks, Sudbury, Moa (Cuba), Philippine HPAL
  3. RefiningClass 1 metal · nickel sulphateIndonesia, China, Canada, Russia, Japan, Norway
  4. Materials & partsStainless · alloys · pCAM → CAM → cellsChina, Korea, Japan
  5. Into US & CanadaMetal, scrap, and nickel inside batteriesUS: stainless, alloys, EVs

Map 2 of 2

CoCobalt pathways to the US & Canada

From the DR Congo's Copperbelt and nickel operations in Indonesia, the Philippines and Canada, through refineries in China, Finland, Norway, Japan and Canada, into US superalloys, chemicals and batteries.

73%
of 2025 mined cobalt came from the DR Congo; Indonesia 14%27
>75%
of refined cobalt was produced in China in 202512
26%
of US cobalt imports come from Norway; Finland 16%, Canada 14%, Japan 14%27
79%
US net import reliance for cobalt in 202527
  1. MineCopper-cobalt ore · Ni-Co oreDR Congo, Indonesia, Russia, Madagascar, Australia, Philippines
  2. Primary processingCobalt hydroxide · MHP · MSP · Ni-Co matteDRC mine sites, Indonesian HPAL, Sudbury
  3. RefiningCobalt metal · sulphate · oxide · powderChina, Finland, Japan, Canada, Indonesia, Norway
  4. Materials & partspCAM → CAM → cells · superalloysChina, Korea, Japan
  5. Into US & CanadaMetal, chemicals, and cobalt inside batteriesUS: jet engines, chemicals
